five_bags_vio.scope:
Stream real bag timing through the VIO supervisor and map/control reset callbacks.

Does not replay topics or construct a robot backend/SDK. Cache markers explicitly
exercise invalidation; this is not full perception replanning or physical replay.

five_bags_control.scope: Recorded path conversion only; not a closed-loop physical replay

bag_scope: Read-only sensor-timing and actual supervisor/reset/control callbacks with explicit cache markers; not full perception replay or fixed physical trajectories.
simulation_scope: 1.2 m flight and landing, levels 10, combined scale .5 seed 7; full tasks inject at 3 seconds and midflight tasks at 15 seconds. No healthy-state operator confirmation calls. Truth unaffected.
limitations: Actual navcore runtime configuration must be verified on that device.
min_wall was already .3: this change does not establish resolution of field stair/obstacle confusion.
Slow VIO drift, pure attitude jumps, DDS/SDK execution and real braking distance not established.
Previously known open-door platform scenarios remain unresolved/unvalidated.
